claim_text: G0 is the charge-zero Gaussian control in the canonical family.
notes: Control definition and relative morphology; absolute scale remains separately calibrated.

claim_text: B0 is the charge-zero bright-core Bessel reference in the canonical family.
notes: Bright-core Bessel reference, not a vortex.

claim_text: V1 preserves charge-one transverse phase winding in both scalar and vector focal references.
notes: Measured winding is 1 within numerical precision on the identified dominant transverse component; this is numerical topology, not an experimental measurement.

claim_text: V3 preserves charge-three transverse phase winding in both scalar and vector focal references.
notes: Measured winding is 3 within numerical precision on the identified dominant transverse component; this is numerical topology, not an experimental measurement.

claim_text: At the matched Phase 2C objective focal plane the scalar and vector ring radii agree for V1 and V3.
notes: V1 radius 0.7203 um and V3 radius 1.5435 um in the nominal model; any report number must identify this focal plane and scalar/vector reference.

claim_text: Phase 2C reports nominal dark-core radii for V1 and V3 while preserving their winding.
notes: Vector-reference dark-core radii are 0.5145 um and 1.1319 um in the nominal focal model; camera/objective calibration is required for physical comparison.

claim_text: Scalar and vector objective side-lobe ratios are quantitatively recorded for G0, B0, V1 and V3.
notes: Use solver-specific values; do not collapse scalar and vector results into one unlabeled number.

claim_text: Scalar focusing is an acceptable broad-morphology approximation for G0 and B0 within the Phase 2C benchmark.
notes: Bounded project benchmark only; vector Debye remains available and longitudinal fields are not modelled by the scalar route.

notes: Use Debye for quantitative peak location; nominal scalar-vector shifts are 1.029 um for V1 and 2.3009139488 um for V3.

claim_text: The scalar normal-incidence interface approximation is acceptable for the bounded Phase 2C morphology and power comparison.
notes: Uses the project material/index and uncoated bounded comparison; component-resolved or changed-interface claims require vector Fresnel and calibration.

claim_text: The 0.02-0.06 m axial interval is a historical Phase 2A configuration reference only; it is not a measured Bessel zone and not the final source-scale axial prediction.

It must not be reported as a measured Bessel zone or as the final source-scale axial result. Final measured source-scale zones are VTX-C26/C27/C28. claim_text: Each canonical case has analytic, ideal, realistic fixed-bench, mild-error and deliberately degraded controlled variants.
notes: Mild and degraded variants are diagnostics, not predictions of a measured bench state.

claim_text: The realistic route explicitly models phase-only SLM geometry, selected-order filtering, pupil capture and nominal throughput.
notes: Hardware values labelled assumed or calibration_required must not be described as measured.

notes: Full conjugation that removes winding is permitted only as an explicitly acknowledged diagnostic.

claim_text: Phase 2B 2D views and transverse 3D surfaces render accepted native metrics with interpolation used only for display.
notes: The 3D vertical axis is intensity, not propagation distance.

notes: Only recovered rows marked quantitatively valid may be reused; retained blocked diagnostics remain blocked.

claim_text: Phase 2C Debye quadrature and canonical-grid convergence pass their predeclared numerical checks.
notes: Convergence validates the numerical reference, not laboratory agreement.

notes: Requires real camera/objective scale, pulse energy, stage transmissions and related hardware measurements.

claim_text: The repository does not predict nonlinear material modification, pulse accumulation, thermal response or ablation.
notes: Linear optical propagation and calibration governance only.

claim_text: The final source-scale route is SLM phase-only modulation, common 4F selected-order filtering, carrier removal, no additional real-space aperture, one physical axicon, then band-limited angular-spectrum propagation in air.
notes: Phase 2E outcome PHASE2E-FINAL-A. Zero objective transforms and exactly one axicon; the z origin is the physical axicon output plane. The finite Gaussian envelope and SLM/numerical support remain, so this is not an infinite-aperture model. SOURCE-SCALE only; experimental_calibration_required = true.

claim_text: The production source grid is N=3072 over a fixed 10 mm window, giving dx=3.255208 um and 19.7646 samples per axicon radial phase period; N=2048 and N=2560 fail the predeclared 1% axial-detail gates.
notes: Source-sampling convergence of the source-scale route. The accepted complex64 production backend was checked against complex128 BL-ASM with maximum field L2 difference 2.714e-6. This validates the numerical reference, not laboratory agreement.

claim_text: Production propagation uses z=0-180 mm with dz=0.25 mm; the representative 0-140 mm comparison against dz=0.125 mm passes every declared convergence gate.
notes: Worst raw L2 difference is 6.291e-4 for V3 and the maximum useful-zone boundary shift is 0.125 mm. Numerical z-step convergence only; it is not an experimental axial-resolution claim.

claim_text: The nominal no-additional-aperture route is the primary source-scale report prediction for B0, V1 and V3.
notes: Route report_eligibility is primary. The route-level calibration_required=false flag means ONLY that no additional aperture calibration is needed to define this numerical route. claim_text: Pronounced axial beading appears only under the hard 1.8 mm disk truncation and is a diagnostic, not the nominal experimental prediction.
notes: For B0 over 25-90 mm the detrended ripple RMS is 0.00109 with no additional aperture, 0.00113 for the soft assumption and 0.07810 for the hard disk; peak-to-valley is 0.00448, 0.00470 and 0.34672. claim_text: Phase 2E source-scale propagation and Phase 2C objective/sample-scale focal results are separate scales and must not be merged or interchanged.
notes: SOURCE-SCALE means tens of mm axial propagation with tens of um transverse Bessel/ring scale. OBJECTIVE/SAMPLE-SCALE means the Phase 2C Debye focal plane at approximately micron transverse scale. Phase 2E does not alter or supersede any Phase 2C focal claim; VTX-C03 to VTX-C10 remain authoritative for vector focal results.
